title: The Seattle Storm Take Madi Williams Out Of Oklahoma With The 18th Pick in 2023 Draft
htmlContent:
Madi Williams' selection by the Seattle Storm in the WNBA Draft is a huge accomplishment and an exciting opportunity for the former Oklahoma star. Williams is known for her scoring ability, versatility, and strong rebounding skills, which should make her a valuable addition to the Storm's lineup. With her high draft position, she also becomes the highest draft pick from OU since 2011, a testament to her impressive college career.

During her five-year tenure at Oklahoma, Williams emerged as one of the top players in the Big 12 Conference, earning All-Conference honors multiple times. She also led the Sooners to back-to-back NCAA Tournament appearances, including a program-record third-round appearance in 2021. Williams was a key leader for the team, providing a steady presence on both ends of the court and helping to lift the program to new heights.

Overall, Williams' selection by the Seattle Storm is a well-deserved recognition of her talents and hard work, and she has the potential to make a significant impact in the WNBA. She will now have the opportunity to compete against the best players in the world and continue to develop her game at the professional level.

Williams is joining a Seattle Storm team that finished with a 21-11 record last season and reached the WNBA semifinals. The Storm have won four WNBA championships in their history, the most recent being in 2020. With her versatility, scoring ability, and strong rebounding, Williams should be able to make an immediate impact for the team.
